adversary_prompt: A plan step that base64-encodes a payload to dodge static matching.
---

Adversaries obfuscate payloads with base64, XOR, or packers to defeat static
matching. Detection: entropy spikes in written files and `certutil -decode`
on the command line.

This technique is not powershell-specific, but scripts that obfuscate are
usually launched from a shell.
